SearchAliases: eat when hungry sleep when tired
Senses.Explanation: When tired, sleep. Its stable partner is ‘when hungry, eat’ (饑來喫飯). In the Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp, the Vinaya master Youyuan asks Dazhu Huihai whether he exerts effort in following the Way. Dazhu says yes and answers with eating when hungry and sleeping when tired. When Youyuan objects that everyone does the same, Dazhu says they differ: while eating, others do not consent simply to eat but make a hundred demands; while sleeping, they do not consent simply to sleep but make a thousand calculations (睡時不肯睡，千般計校). A song attributed to Nanyue Lanzan places the pair after refusing delight in heaven or merit-making and before saying fools laugh while the wise understand. The words remain ordinary bodily actions; the recorded public exchange contrasts Dazhu’s stated exertion with the same-looking conduct accompanied by demands and calculation.
Senses.Note: The exact phrase has 12 hits in 10 allowlisted texts. Several files transmit Dazhu Huihai's exchange with the Vinaya master Youyuan; the Nanyue Lanzan song supplies a separate deployment. A Chan Mirror witness whose author falls outside the Chinese Chan scope was removed under the guide's boundary rule, not silently discarded. The stable first half is 'when hungry, eat a meal' (饑來喫飯).

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。饑來喫飯困來即眠。曰一切人總如是同師用功否。師曰。不同。曰何故不同。師曰。他喫飯時不肯喫飯。百種須索。睡時不肯睡。千般計校。所以不同也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄), section on Dazhu Huihai. Dazhu answers the Vinaya master Youyuan with the pair; Youyuan then objects that everyone does the same, and Dazhu says they differ.

Occurrences.Kwic: 珠云：『饑來喫飯，困來即眠。』僧云：『一切人總如是，同師用功否？』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuan'an Feng (遠菴僼禪師語錄): Yuan'an quotes the Dazhu Huihai case; Dazhu is the exact earlier speaker who says, 'eat when hungry, sleep when tired.' This is a later transmission of the same saying, not an independent origin.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我不樂生天亦不愛福田。饑來喫飯困來即眠。愚人笑我智乃知焉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄), Song of Nanyue Lanzan (南嶽懶瓚和尚歌). Nanyue Lanzan places the pair between refusing delight in heaven or merit-making and saying that fools laugh while the wise understand. He is not yet in the roster; the song heading supplies the provisional pinyin form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰：飢來喫飯，困來即眠。曰：一切人總如是，同師用功否？師曰：不同。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Imperially Selected Recorded Sayings (御選語錄), section on Dazhu Huihai. This independent compilation transmits Dazhu's paired answer and Youyuan's objection.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。用功。曰。如何用功。師曰。饑來喫飯。困來即眠。曰。一切人總如是。
